title: Wix Management
meta: A starter round of content updates, fixes and care for your Wix site, done for you in your own account. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Wix management, updates done for you
overview: This is a fixed starter sprint for Wix owners who would rather not do the updates themselves. We review your site, fix what is broken, then work through your list: new text and photos, product or service changes, blog posts, booking settings and form checks. You get a short report of what we did. Monthly care is not part of this price, and we quote it separately if you want us to carry on.

faq: No. It is one fixed starter sprint. If it works for you, we can quote monthly care separately with a written scope. There is no automatic renewal on this order.
How do I send you the updates?
List them in the order form or send a document with text and images. We confirm the list back to you first so we both agree what the sprint covers before we start.
Can you manage my Wix store orders?
This sprint covers site updates and product edits. Daily order handling is a different, ongoing job that we quote separately. Tell us if you need it and we scope it with you.
What if I run out of included updates?
We finish the most important ones first and send you the rest as a short list. You can upgrade the package or order another sprint. We never add costs without your agreement.
